values.name: Unit net weight
values.description: [6160] Weight (mass) of goods including any packing normally going with them to a buyer in a retail sale.

values.name: Unit gross weight
values.description: [6292] Weight (mass) of goods including packing but excluding the carrier's equipment.

values.name: Total net weight
values.description: Total weight of goods excluding packaging.

values.name: Total gross weight
values.description: [6292] Weight (mass) of goods including packing but excluding the carrier's equipment.

values.name: Item gross weight
values.description: Gross weight at line item level.

values.name: Net net weight
values.description: [6048] Weight (mass) of the goods themselves without any packing.

values.name: Stern thrust
values.description: Force exerted by a thruster installed at the stern of a vessel.

values.name: Bow thrust
values.description: Force exerted by a thruster installed at the bow of a vessel.

values.name: Hydrate content of an alcoholic product at bottling
values.description: The hydrate content of an alcoholic product at the moment of bottling.

values.name: Number of units per pallet
values.description: The number of units contained on a pallet.

values.name: Fat content
values.description: An indication of the fat content of a product.

values.name: Net weight
values.description: [6160] Weight (mass) of goods including any packing normally going with them to a buyer in a retail sale.

values.name: Gross tonnage of the vessel
values.description: [6300] The measure of the overall size of a ship determined in accordance with the provisions of the International Convention on Tonnage Measurement of Ships, 1969.

values.name: Net tonnage of the vessel
values.description: [6302] The measure of the useful capacity of a ship determined in accordance with the provisions of the International Convention on Tonnage Measurement of Ships, 1969.

values.name: Operative temperature
values.description: Temperature identified system or process works according to specifications.

values.name: Non operative temperature
values.description: Temperature identified system or process does not work according to specifications.

values.name: Gross volume
values.description: The observed volume unadjusted for factors such as temperature or gravity.

values.name: Net volume
values.description: The observed volume after adjustment for factors such as temperature or gravity.

values.name: Item width when unrolled
values.description: The width of an item when unrolled.

values.name: Item length when unrolled
values.description: The length of an item when unrolled.

values.name: Item area when unrolled
values.description: The area occupied by an item when unrolled.

values.name: Original wort
values.description: Measure of the malt and hops content of beer, before fermentation has taken place.

values.name: Volume
values.description: The amount of air space taken up by the entity identified in the 6311 qualifier.

values.name: Conveyance summer dead weight
values.description: Registered summer dead weight total tonnage of the vessel.

values.name: Containerized cargo on vessel's weight
values.description: Total weight of containerized cargo on vessel.

values.name: Non-containerized cargo on vessel's weight
values.description: Total weight of non-containerized cargo on vessel.

values.name: Weight ascertained
values.description: [4240] Endorsement of the true weight (mass) as ascertained or verified by the railway (CIM 81).

values.name: Chargeable weight
values.description: The weight on which charges are based.

values.name: Estimated gross weight
values.description: Estimated weight (mass) of goods, including packing and excluding carrier's.

values.name: Estimated volume
values.description: Estimated size or measure of anything in three dimensions.

values.name: Vessel overall length
values.description: Total overall length of the vessel.

values.name: Loading meters
values.description: The length in a vehicle, whereby the complete width and height over that length is needed for the goods.

values.name: Number of axles
values.description: Number of axles of movable equipment or means of transport on wheels.

values.name: Payload
values.description: The revenue-producing load carried by a means of transport.

values.name: Start position in the length
values.description: The starting position from the beginning of an item located in the length direction.

values.name: End position in the length
values.description: The end position from the beginning of an item located in the length direction.

values.name: Start position in the width
values.description: The start position from the beginning of an item located in the width direction.

values.name: End position in the width
values.description: The end position from the beginning of an item located in the width direction.

values.name: Start position in the thickness
values.description: The start position from the beginning of an item located in the thickness direction.

values.name: End position in the thickness
values.description: The end position from the beginning of an item located in the thickness direction.

values.name: Transport container actual filling weight
values.description: Actual filling weight of a transport container.

values.name: Transport container maximum capacity
values.description: Maximum capacity of a transport container.

values.name: Declared net weight
values.description: The declared net weight of a product or products used for invoicing, customs or transport purposes.

values.name: Loading height
values.description: Maximum height of products or packages loaded onto a given transportation device or equipment such as a pallet.

values.name: Stacking height
values.description: Maximum height up to which the same product or package may be placed one upon the other for storage purposes.

values.name: Calculated weight
values.description: The calculated weight of the item based on the ordered dimensions.

values.name: Impurity
values.description: The impurity of the product i.e. the measurement of other chemical elements not normally appearing in a product.

values.name: Drained weight
values.description: The weight of a product when all liquids used in the packaging of the product have been removed.

values.name: Equipment storage limitation
values.description: Maximum storage limit of the equipment.

values.name: Radioactive index of transport
values.description: The index of transport determines the maximum radiation level at a distance of 1m from the external surface.

values.name: Average gross weight
values.description: Weight which is the outcome of the division of the total gross weight by the number of units.

values.name: Forward draft
values.description: Depth of water from the surface of water to the bottom of the vessel measured at the draft mark of the bow.

values.name: After draft
values.description: Depth of water from the surface of water to the bottom of the vessel measured at the draft mark of the stern.

values.name: Transport equipment gross weight
values.description: Weight of a transport equipment including the cargo and carrier's equipment.

values.name: Total transport equipment gross weight
values.description: Total weight of all transport equipment including the cargo and carrier's equipment.

values.name: Penetrometry
values.description: Measurement of force required to drive a standard penetrating stamp.

values.name: Durofel
values.description: Measurement of the elastic force using a standard penetrating stamp.

values.name: Juice weight per 100 grams
values.description: Measurement of weight of juice, based on 100 grams of the entire weight.

values.name: Fruit skin colour
values.description: Measurement of the colouring of the epidermis of a fruit.

values.name: Fixed incremental measurement
values.description: The measurement of the fixed increment.

values.name: Durofel D10
values.description: Measure of the elastic force of the pulp of a fruit. It is measured with a penetrating stamp with diameter 10.

values.name: Durofel D25
values.description: Measure of the elastic force of the pulp of a fruit. It is measured with a penetrating stamp with diameter 25.

values.name: Durofel D50
values.description: Measure of the elastic force of the pulp of a fruit. It is measured with a penetrating stamp with diameter 50.

values.name: Maximum stacking weight
values.description: The maximum weight which may be stacked upon a product or package without the product or packaging being crushed.

values.name: Gross measure cube
values.description: The total cubic space occupied by an item, taking into account any protruding components, arrived at by multiplying the maximum length, width and height.

values.name: Percentage fat content in dry matter
values.description: The percentage of fat content in dry matter.

values.name: Saccharometric content
values.description: Measurement of the sugar content of a solution.

values.name: Hydrate content of an alcoholic product after bottling
values.description: The hydrate content which occurs in an alcoholic product after bottling.

values.name: Platinum
values.description: The measurement of the platinum component.

values.name: Silver
values.description: The measurement of the silver component.

values.name: List
values.description: The leaning or inclination of a vessel expressed in degrees port or starboard.

values.name: Trim
values.description: The condition of a vessel with reference to its longitudinal axis.

values.name: Free water
values.description: The volume of water present in a container that is not in suspension in the contained liquid.

values.name: API (American Petroleum Institute) gravity
values.description: The relative density of petroleum liquids as specified by a standard developed by the API.

values.name: Petroleum gross observed volume
values.description: The total volume of all petroleum liquids and sediment and water, excluding free water, at observed temperature and pressure.

values.name: Petroleum gross standard volume
values.description: The total volume of all petroleum liquids, sediment, and water excluding free water, corrected by the appropriate volume correction factor for the observed temperature and American Petroleum Institute relative density, or density to a standard temperature.

values.name: Volume variance
values.description: The change in the volume measurement.

values.name: Petroleum net standard volume
values.description: The total volume of all petroleum liquids, excluding sediment and water and free water, corrected by the appropriate volume correction factor for the observed temperature and American Petroleum Institute gravity relative to density or to a standard temperature.

values.name: Material on-board quantity, after discharge
values.description: The material in vessel tanks, void spaces, and pipelines after discharge.

values.name: Petroleum total calculated volume
values.description: The total volume of all petroleum liquids, sediment and water corrected by the appropriate volume correction factor for the observed temperature and American Petroleum Institute (API) gravity, relative density, or density to a standard temperature.

values.name: Petroleum total observed volume
values.description: The total volume of all petroleum liquids, sediment and water and free water at observed temperature and pressure.

values.name: Innage gauge distance
values.description: The measured distance from the surface of the liquid to a fixed datum plate or to the tank bottom.

values.name: Petroleum net standard weight
values.description: The total weight of all petroleum liquids excluding sediments, water and free water.

values.name: Sediment and water in petroleum
values.description: The measurement of non-hydrocarbon solid material and water in suspension in petroleum liquid.

values.name: Observed reference height, tank
values.description: The observed distance from the tank bottom or datum plate to the established reference point.

values.name: Reference height, tank
values.description: The measured distance from the tank bottom or datum plate to the established reference point.

values.name: Ullage gauge distance
values.description: The measured distance from the cargo liquid surface to the reference point.

values.name: Trim correction
values.description: The correction applied to the observed gauge or observed volume when a vessel is not on an even keel.

values.name: Bow to bridge distance
values.description: The distance between the bow and the bridge of a vessel.

values.name: Breaking strength wet
values.description: The measured breaking strength when wet.

values.name: Contents of package
values.description: In combination with the other data elements of the actual segment this code indicates the measured content of a package.

values.name: Commercial weight
values.description: Item weight considering its maximum possible humidity.

values.name: Core length
values.description: To specify length of core on which product is to be placed.

values.name: Destination weight agreement
values.description: The agreed weight of despatched goods whose weight may change during transport.

values.name: Denier
values.description: The measured fineness of a material.

values.name: Width, boxcar door
values.description: The measured width of a boxcar door.

values.name: Filament count
values.description: Used e.g. in textile, print industries.

values.name: Gross weight
values.description: [6292] Weight (mass) of goods including packing but excluding the carrier's equipment.

values.name: Length dimension
values.description: (6168) Length of pieces or packages stated for transport purposes.

values.name: Moisture
values.description: Measurement application is the moisture content of the item.

values.name: Actual net weight
values.description: The actual weight of the goods excluding packaging.

values.name: Pre stretch
values.description: Measurement identifying the amount an item has been stretched prior to use.

values.name: Rockwell C
values.description: Hardness in the Rockwell C scale.

values.name: Tare weight
values.description: Weight excluding goods and loose accessories.

values.name: Temperature
values.description: A measurement in relation to temperature.

values.name: Time period
values.description: Measurement of a specific length of time.

values.name: Height, van door
values.description: The height of the door of a van or container.

values.name: Width, van door
values.description: The width of the door of a van or container.

values.name: Weight per unit of area
values.description: The weight per unit of an area.

values.name: Width, maximum
values.description: The maximum distance from side to side.

values.name: Weight per unit of length
values.description: The weight per unit of length.

values.name: Side height, flat bed with removable sides
values.description: The height of the removable sides of a flat bed truck.

values.name: Iron plus silicon
values.description: The measured substance iron plus silicon.

values.name: Mutually defined
values.description: A code assigned within a code list to be used on an interim basis and as defined among trading partners until a precise code can be assigned to the code list.
